role: The thrown eye of ender that flies toward the nearest stronghold, trailing portal particles, then drops as an item or shatters.

members.name: targetX
members.note: item_entity.h's eye_target_x, set by the moveTowards clamp

members.name: EntityEnderEye
members.note: EntityList's NBT constructor: cov-reload-s1 saves an eye in flight with its chunk and reads it back (then it heads for 0, 0: readEntityFromNBT reads nothing)

members.name: EntityEnderEye
members.note: position, yOffset 0, despawnTimer 0; ItemEnderEye's throw builds this ctor

members.name: moveTowards
members.note: the >12 distance clamp toward the stronghold, targetY + 8, and the shatterOrDrop draw

members.name: setVelocity
members.note: the client copy's S12 handler on the WorldClient copy; the replay keeps no client copy of an eye (canBeCollidedWith is false, so the pick never needs it) and nothing in the state reads the copy's motion

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: flight toward the target, rotation blending, the two portal-particle rand draws when not in water, despawn at 80 and the item drop; the no-drop branch's playAuxSFX(2003) on the server only sends the S28 (env_aux_sfx, lane/chainfuzz: it was not sent; pfc-eyeshatter-g28), whose particles and WorldClient.rand draws are the client's (particles_live.c particles_live_aux)

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: the IE_ENDER_EYE case writes nothing, matching the empty vanilla body

members.name: canAttackWithItem
members.note: the eye's canBeCollidedWith is false: the pick never selects it, so no melee reaches the false answer

notes: The server throw (ItemEnderEye.onItemRightClick: findClosestStructure, the (World,double,double,double) ctor, moveTowards, the itemRand bow pitch) is csrc/engine/throw.c:throw_server_use's IT_ENDER_EYE case calling csrc/engine/projectile.c:proj_throw_ender_eye, which uses stronghold_nearest_loaded. ItemEnderEye.onItemUse (portal frame filling) is a separate file's surface (csrc/engine/place.c:eye_use, csrc/engine/itemuse.c:eye_use) and is not a member of this class. test_eyes.c replays proj_spawn_ender_eye, proj_use_ender_eye and the stronghold targets; throw-items-s1 shows three eyes flying, two dropping and one shattering. lane/idxentity: the three open members were client presentation or unreachable; the server flight is exact on throw-items-s1.
